title: Infographic: Injection Molding Order Timeline
summary: From order placed to parts delivered, see a timeline of a typical injection molding order and learn about how Xometry's process works.
body_markdown:
Injection molding with Xometry is one of the most cost-effective methods for producing consistent, high-quality plastic parts at scale. Compared with other manufacturing processes, it has the broadest range of materials, colors, and finishing options, allowing for endless customization.


However, this manufacturing process is complex and involves multiple phases before finished parts can be produced. With instant quoting for tooling and parts, project management support, and industry experts who will work with you along the way, Xometry simplifies your[injection molding](https://www.xometry.com/capabilities/injection-molding-quote/) journey. Learn more by downloading our infographic that outlines every step along the way, so you know what to expect when starting a new molding project.
